title: GUIYI Task Runtime Overlay V1.0
description: Local-only runtime overlay for GitHub Native task execution. Files live under .ai/task-runtime/<TASK_ID>.json and must not be committed.

task_id.description: Task ID matching the static task contract.

worktree.description: Local absolute path to the git worktree for this task. Local-only; never commit.

local_branch.description: Local branch currently checked out for this task.

last_dispatch_exit_code.description: Exit code of the most recent dispatcher stage.

last_sync_at.description: Last runtime overlay sync timestamp in UTC.

updated_by.description: Local actor that last updated this runtime overlay.

notes.description: Short local-only note. Do not include secrets.
